_comment: A combination result of Slow and LongRangeStrike: damage at Long-Range Strike's radius plus a slow at the same radius, each about 70 percent of its parent's numbers. The slow shares the damage aura's tick interval rather than ticking every tick, so it can be late applying to an entering target and lingers after the target leaves, favoring this aura's kiting style. All values placeholder.
name: Suppression
